_about: Ground truth for the demonstration scenarios. Each log is synthetic (lab-style) data. 'expected_alerts' are the rule names that must fire; 'attack' is false for the benign baseline, which must raise no alerts. Used by tests/test_scenarios.py and for evaluation (TC-EVAL-01, TC-EVAL-02).
